package rulefixtures

import (
	"strings"
)

// scenario for strings_index_any_not_minus_one_contains_any: `strings.IndexAny(...) != -1` presence checks instead of `strings.ContainsAny(...)`.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: info.
func scenario658Positive(s, chars string) bool {
	return strings.IndexAny(s, chars) != -1
}
